scope: Bounded read-only primary-literature search; no novelty/completeness assessment; source caches outside repository; selected passages read, not all proof/code independently reproduced.
search_new_first_submission_utc_cutoff: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z through2026-10-08T23:59:00Z for dated queries only; no claim to revision-complete date coverage
selected_source_dates_checked: All selected first-submission/revision times precede retrieval and user-facing date.
future_same_day_cutoff_limit: Dated searches use end-of-UTC-day expression; actual server results captured at retrieval time, not later material.
tls: Default Python TLS certificate and hostname verification retained; no disabled checks, credentials, remote writes or settings changes.
